events.name: Taking Reign
events.summary: The year-long Reign of Talon story reaches its finale in Rialto. Play and complete challenges to earn rewards from a 24-tier Event Pass.

pass.note: Once bought, the premium track can be finished at any time, Season 6 included.

events.rewardsNote: The highlights Blizzard named. The pass holds more.

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: Overwatch x EVE Protocol
events.summary: Five EVE Protocol characters arrive as Hero skins: Widowmaker as EVE, D.Va as Lily, Freja as Raven, Vendetta as Tachy and Soldier: 76 as Adam.

image.credit: Blizzard Entertainment. ©2024~2026 SHIFT UP Corp. All rights reserved.

notes: D.Va's Lily is an Ultra skin with its own kill effects, reactions and Hello emote, and her mech is based on the Providence boss.

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: Excavation Initiative
events.summary: The dig is back. Finish digs each week to earn Loot Boxes.

challenges.reward: More Loot Boxes, Epic Loot Boxes and a Legendary Loot Box

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: Junkrat's Loot Hunt
events.summary: Finish games to earn Loot Boxes at your own pace, with Double XP for the whole event.

challenges.task: Complete 5 games. Repeat up to 9 times, with no daily reset

notes: Double XP is on for the whole event.

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: Quick Play and Competitive Drives
events.summary: Drives return with separate tracks for Competitive and Quick Play, and you can take on both.

rewards.name: Up to 3,000 Competitive Points and a Signature

notes: Reach the fourth checkpoint this season to equip eligible earlier Signatures.

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: OWCS World Finals Cheer Rally
events.summary: Complete in-game challenges to earn Cheer and claim rewards while the 2026 World Finals play out in Guangzhou.
notes: The World Finals run December 2 to 6. Watching on Twitch or YouTube with a linked account earns more rewards.

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: Black Friday Vault Sale
events.summary: Older cosmetics, some of them hard to find, return in themed shop bundles.
notes: Bundles named: Peak Mega Bundle, Hero Spotlight Bundles for Mercy, Soldier: 76, Ramattra and D.Va, 2026 Mega Unvault Bundle, Tank, Support and Damage Essentials Bundle 2, and StarCraft Mega Bundle.

sources.title: Reign of Talon – S5 Midcycle Sets Up the Showdown

events.name: Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games
events.summary: This year's Halloween event: a mode where every death brings random new powers, with a new Event Pass each week.

modes.name: Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games
modes.about: Enter as a random Hero and come back from each death with random new powers. The roster grew to 20 Heroes during the event.

challenges.task: Collect Offerings from challenges and pledge them to Ashe, Moira or Winston
challenges.reward: Battle Pass XP for each Offering. The Hero with the most joined the mode next

pass.note: A new Event Pass each week, each ending in a milestone reward.

sources.title: Feed Your Hunger in Reign of Talon – Season 5: A Grim Doctrine

events.name: Overwatch x Shadow Monarch
events.summary: Hunters and Shadow Army characters arrive as Hero skins: Genji as Sung Jinwoo, Reaper as Igris, Anran as Cha Hae-In, Reinhardt as Iron and Lifeweaver as Choi Jong-In.

sources.title: Feed Your Hunger in Reign of Talon – Season 5: A Grim Doctrine

events.name: Tech Witches Collection
events.summary: Halloween skins that trade broomsticks for technology, for D.Mon, Shion, Juno, Sierra and Jetpack Cat.

sources.title: Feed Your Hunger in Reign of Talon – Season 5: A Grim Doctrine

events.name: Team Drives
events.summary: Queue alone or with friends. After a win, matched teammates stay together for the next game.

rewards.name: A Dynamic Title
rewards.note: For the first 10,000 groups to finish the final Trial

notes: Staying together speeds your climb through the Gladiator Ranks. Finish your Competitive placements first.

sources.title: Feed Your Hunger in Reign of Talon – Season 5: A Grim Doctrine
